reviewer.identity: Codex independent user-facing quality review agent /root/source_catalogue
reviewer.scope_separation: The reviewer did not author or edit the generated bundle, governed inputs, existing G6 evidence, accessibility scanner, browser journey implementation, security checks or performance budgets.

checks.method: Compared the evidence candidate identity with Git HEAD and the release-root marker in bundle/CHECKSUMS.sha256.
checks.result: The evidence, frozen commit and bundle all identify commit edbe2cb61a3d916bc149519ad489f957c5ee3a38 and release root a3c15f0ee3c104e8b8f82ab770edd1b2ec9b16b2d72a9e2c4a6a1281e5b80c3c.

checks.method: Reviewed the exact-candidate axe results for all three declared routes and independently inspected the rendered accessibility tree and static progressive-enhancement requirements.
checks.result: The evidence records zero automated violations on /, /accessibility.html and /catalogue-index.html. The independent rendered sample found a descriptive title, one level-one heading, banner/navigation/main/footer landmarks, a labelled searchbox, live result status, visible release limitations and a navigable no-script catalogue fallback.

checks.method: Ran a bounded Playwright keyboard and interaction sample against the frozen bundle served locally.
checks.result: The first Tab target was the skip link; a submitted search survived reload; browser Back restored the prior submitted query; progressive loading expanded 24 results to 48 and focused the first newly added article; the high-risk search exposed portal, Local Land Charges and Business Gateway access and rights caveats.

checks.method: Reviewed the exact-candidate browser/security evidence and inspected the authored CSP, external-runtime boundary and unsafe-DOM-sink tests.
checks.result: No critical finding is recorded. The page declares a restrictive self-only CSP, the authored JavaScript avoids the tested unsafe DOM sinks, runtime assets are local, and restricted services remain external links rather than invoked dependencies.

checks.method: Independently recomputed raw bytes, system-gzip bytes, bundle file count and total published bytes from the frozen bundle.
checks.result: All evidence values reproduced exactly: authored shell 48,221 raw and 12,773 gzip bytes; search index 2,894,919 raw and 187,698 gzip bytes; 43 published files totalling 22,168,820 bytes. Every declared maximum is met.

checks.method: Compared the evidence with REQ-012, REQ-013, docs/accessibility.md and the G6 release criterion.
checks.result: The evidence supports the declared progressive-enhancement, bounded-loading, automated and agent-assisted journey, critical-security and performance claims without asserting WCAG conformance or human assurance.

limitations: No independent human accessibility audit, representative-user research or qualified assistive-technology evaluation was performed.
This AI-agent review does not make a WCAG conformance claim.
The independent browser work was a bounded sample, not a second execution of every axe rule, contrast state, zoom level, forced-colour mode, preference mode or browser and screen-reader combination.
The production GitHub Pages deployment remains subject to the declared post-deployment recheck.
decision: Accept G6 for the exact frozen proof-of-concept candidate, subject to the explicit limitations above.
